observed: Per-J/parity orbital-bank solves and block RCI are genuinely implemented despite stale no-op/scaffold comments. They use statistical DF, not same-J/parity PCFI partitions; fixed CI state_average rejects the flag.
Real signed overlaps between different common orbital banks, complete cluster/pair gates and fixed-amplitude overlap derivatives exist. Each bank must be orthonormal in the same radial metric.

One-body transition cofactors exist and remain valid at singular cross-orbital overlap; the consumer performs this direct contraction, not a biorthogonal orbital/CI transformation. It chooses one bank per J/parity endpoint and skips small amplitude products, so it is not full multi-bank PCFI transition support.

The inspected overlap/angular/transition/per-block components are byte-identical to f043. Current methods/ci.py and physics/csf/matrix.py differ (centered diagonalization and semiseparable radial route); historical f043 Yb results are not current-source certification.
genuinely_missing: Method partition policy and bank identity; full strong-reference P retention; explicit frozen-reference columns and partition orbital objective. Existing complete-kappa optimizer layout and gradient_keys do not implement a certified frozen-column manifold.

Full cross-bank scalar one-body and all two-body H with correct complementary overlap minors, bank-indexed raw radial integrals, complete signed phases and all interpartition interference. One-body tensor cofactors or the ordinary single-bank radial evaluator are insufficient.
Owned joint many-electron overlap S and H, generalized CI Hc=E Sc, exact dependency/physical-rank handling, actual c.T S c normalization, generalized residual and physical root/subspace identity.
Result and transition consumers where one physical state contains P and several same-sector partition banks; explicit support/rejection by operator coverage and no small coefficient pruning.

For joint orbital optimization, c.T(dH-E dS)c plus contracted-CF response qualification. The existing overlap derivative at fixed amplitudes supplies part of dS, not the complete generalized-CI derivative. Separately optimized CF interaction is a declared method approximation, not global MCDHF stationarity.

minimal_native_ownership.methods: Small methods/csf partition orchestration using native CSFOrbitalFunctional and the current optimizer after a qualified frozen-reference constraint; no second SCF engine or external replacement backend.
minimal_native_ownership.physics_angular: Extend existing signed determinant/overlap/cofactor machinery to bank-pair scalar H and second complementary minors; reuse raw Dirac/radial metric/Coulomb PP/QQ/PQ/QP kernels. Bind bank, CSF, nucleus and no-pair/operator identities; numerical engines must not import method policy.
minimal_native_ownership.numerics_results: Initially a bounded dense generalized symmetric solve on a proved physical metric range. One-particle solve_dirac has boundary/Dirac-sea semantics and is not a many-electron CI solver. Separate many-electron S from radial B-spline S; do not fabricate a common-bank HamiltonianSnapshot or relabel CF coordinates as ordinary orthonormal CSF coefficients.

reference_metric_and_double_count: Every strong-reference CSF remains one explicit variational coordinate. Project/remove each CF reference component in the many-electron metric or prove exact joint dependence; different bank/orbital labels alone do not make functions orthogonal.

Solve one combined P+CF H/S with every H_ab and S_ab cross block; do not sum independent partition energy corrections. This prevents duplicate shared-reference/correlation directions from being treated as independent energy improvements.

Singular cross-orbital overlap is valid and must use determinant/cofactor expressions, never its inverse. Exact null directions of the combined state metric may be quotiented only with proved dependency and H-null compatibility; retain near dependencies or reject with fixed rank/condition gates rather than silently prune modes.

Overlap double-counting and missing disconnected product excitations are different defects. P+CF_A+CF_B does not automatically contain simultaneous A-and-B excitations; include required mixed sectors or declare contraction/truncation coverage. A separable-fragment product-limit qualification is required before a size-consistency claim.

All banks use one fixed N/J/parity sector, nucleus, radial geometry and declared no-pair physical subspace/operator coverage. Different projectors change the Hamiltonian. Keep full signed phases, actual generalized normalization and complete degenerate physical subspaces.

smallest_pre_Yb_qualification.status: Proposal only; separately reviewed resource/input/gate contract required before execution.
smallest_pre_Yb_qualification.fixed_space: N=2; three retained s1/2 radial functions, six spin orbitals, fifteen complete magnetic determinants and six J=0+ CSFs. One real radial metric and common fixed positive-energy space. Two within-bank orthonormal correlation banks obtained by explicit independent rotations within the retained physical orbital space.
smallest_pre_Yb_qualification.reference_partitions: P has two full reference CSFs {1s2,1s1 2s1[J=0+]}; Q_A={2s2,1s1 3s1[J=0+]}; Q_B={2s1 3s1[J=0+],3s2}. Preserve bank labels and verify intended rank/span before comparison. Start with all six uncontracted functions, then one contracted CF per two-CSF Q sector.
smallest_pre_Yb_qualification.analytic_anchor: Direct independent exterior-power map F into the complete common determinant/CSF space: S=F.T F and H=F.T H_common F. For N=2, determinant overlap is det of the2x2 orbital-overlap matrix; scalar one-body terms use first cofactors, and the two-body term is the antisymmetrized bra/ket two-electron integral because the complementary empty minor is1. This remains valid at singular cross-orbital overlap. This is a proposed oracle/derivation, not executed evidence.
gates: Same-bank limit and complete signed off-diagonal phases reproduce ordinary native CSF/DC assembly.
Full rank-six span reproduces six-CSF spectrum; contracted rank-four result is compared with the same four-dimensional physical span and contraction loss reported separately.

Independent orbital/CI phase changes and within-bank rotations, singular cross-overlap, and deliberately duplicated reference/CF columns retain the physical spectrum after proved exact dependency handling.
Predeclare S symmetry/positive physical range, H symmetry, generalized Hc-E Sc residual, c.T S c and complete sector/root-subspace identity gates.
Qualify the one/two-body cofactor H against the exterior-power oracle, then small native Dirac-Coulomb radial integrals before Yb. Joint orbital/metric derivatives are a separate later step.
smallest_pre_Yb_qualification.prospective_bound: At most15 determinant states per bank and225 determinant pairs per bank pair; six distinct P/A/B block pairs total<=1350 pair contractions before minor/component factors. Uncontracted joint6x6 and contracted4x4 matrices; no heavy-atom or cutoff scan.

primary_reference.scope: Parent-provided paper review reports Li/Be/Al validation only. No Yb speed/accuracy or universal superiority is inferred; this source assessment did not re-browse/reproduce the paper.

recommendation: Keep native common-orbital MCDHF->RCI as Yb main route. PCFI is an optional small qualification line after existing physical/stationarity questions, not an immediate migration.
documentation_impact: Only README.md and this source assessment are added. Stale comments are recorded; shared source/current guides/EARS/root full-gradient dirs/cards/publication remain untouched. No new general insight promoted.
